mapper.select: SELECT * FROM team_cert WHERE leader_id = #{leaderId} ORDER BY team_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_cert (leader_id, team_name, credit_code, leader_name, description, service_scope, status, apply_time) VALUES (#{leaderId}, #{teamName}, #{creditCode}, #{leaderName}, #{description}, #{serviceScope}, 1, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE team_cert SET status = #{status}, audit_admin = #{auditAdmin} WHERE team_id = #{teamId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_cert WHERE status = 1
